hook: Their catamaran sank 41 miles out. The dog was aboard too.
narration: This dog rode a rescue basket up from the open ocean, forty-one miles off Oahu.
The seventy-foot catamaran Brandi Anne was sinking, northeast of Oahu's North Shore.
At twelve forty-four in the afternoon, the captain made a mayday call, and the crew abandoned ship into a life raft.
Three men and a dog. A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter crew from Barbers Point flew out to find them.
A rescue basket has floats on its sides, so a survivor just climbs in and sits.
One by one, the basket went down and came back up full.
Then it came up with the dog.
outcome: The Dolphin crew hoisted all three men and the dog into the helicopter.
title: Dog hoisted from a sinking catamaran
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Barbers Point hoisted three men and a dog after the 70-foot catamaran Brandi Anne sank 41 miles northeast of Oahu's North Shore on Aug. 9, 2015.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Barbers Point, U.S. Coast Guard Oceania, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/418649/coast-guard-hoists-survivors-brandi-anne-sinking-near-oahu
